lessons.title: Limit the scope of a claim
lessons.learn: Rewrite an absolute claim so it matches the sample and evidence available.

grammar.title: epistemic scope
grammar.pattern: 就现有证据而言 ...；不能据此断定 ...
grammar.explain: State what the available evidence supports and what it does not establish.

examples.t: 就现有证据而言，这一解释是合理的。
examples.r: jiù xiàn yǒu zhèng jù ér yán，zhè yì jiě shì shì hé lǐ de。
examples.en: On the evidence currently available, this interpretation is reasonable.

examples.t: 样本只包括三个城市。
examples.r: yàng běn zhǐ bāo kuò sān gè chéng shì。
examples.en: The sample includes only three cities.

examples.t: 不能据此断定所有地区都如此。
examples.r: bù néng jù cǐ duàn dìng suǒ yǒu dì qū dōu rú cǐ。
examples.en: This cannot establish that all regions are like this.

mistakes.wrong: 现有证据证明所有地区都一样。
mistakes.right: 现有证据支持有限范围内的解释，不能代表所有地区。
mistakes.why: Do not generalise beyond the sample's scope.

culture.text: In expert communication, a conclusion should match the strength and scope of its evidence. A pause may have several interpretations, and an inference is not an observation. Careful Chinese prose can be concise while marking uncertainty with words such as 可能, 尚 and 就现有证据而言.

reading.text: 就现有证据而言，这是一种可能的解释，还不是最终结论。作者同时说明样本有限，因此读者可以判断这一解释适用到什么范围。
reading.gloss: On the evidence currently available, this is a possible interpretation, not yet a final conclusion. The author also notes that the sample is limited, allowing readers to judge the scope to which the interpretation applies.

listening.script:
专家：沉默能证明对方同意吗？
编辑：不能，沉默可能有不同原因。
专家：请把推断和观察分开写。
编辑：好，我会注明证据的范围。
listening.gloss: Expert: Can silence prove the other person agrees? Editor: No; silence can have different causes. Expert: Please separate inference from observation. Editor: All right, I will state the scope of the evidence.
